prompt: CLEAN-UP PASS ONLY on approved Andromoss alien animation. Keep each exact pose, adult proportions, silhouette, scale, placement and equipment. Be decisive: eliminate dirty white AND LIGHT-GRAY speckles, broken pale edging, stray pixels, noisy highlights and excessive mottled shading. Replace scattered tiny pale flecks on clothing/body with coherent neighboring material colors. Bold clean dark outlines, broad flat color clusters, at most 2-3 shades per material; no dithering, texture, gradients or white/gray edge halos. Preserve sunglasses, normal adult head with rigid skin-continuous crown (NOT HAIR), neck gills, jacket, hook/chain, thin tufted tail and narrow rear braid. Preserve intentional violet hook trail and GOLD sparks as a few clean shapes; do not turn magical effects into white/gray dust. Do not redesign, alter gestures, add objects/text/scenery, enlarge the head or crop appendages. Transparent 192x192; consistent colors and line weight across frames.
